OPS-11: operator PEP DB login (optional part C)
OPS-23: operator: suite copy + own ops credentials (part A), master password (part B)

PLACEHOLDERS.PORTAL_PROFILE: absolute path of the runner's PolyPortal ops browser profile (ADMIN; outside results/)
PLACEHOLDERS.POMA_OPS_PROFILE: absolute path of the runner's POMA ops browser profile (ADMIN; outside results/)
PLACEHOLDERS.PORTAL_ORG: PolyPortal organisation slug of the DeployMate env (deploymate-<uuid>, OPS-G2)
PLACEHOLDERS.RUN_TAG: 8 characters [a-z0-9] for the throw-away names, e.g. the run start MMDDHHmm: organisation e2e-ops-<tag>, tenants e2e-ops-<tag>-test / -prod, plugin e2e-ops-p<tag>, master flag e2e.ops.f<tag>, incidents E2E-OPS-<tag>-*
PLACEHOLDERS.IGNORES_BASELINE: the exact value of portal.onPrem.deephealthcheckIgnores recorded in OPS-G2, or 'no tenant override'

OPS_ROLE_PROFILES.doc: profile folders of the single-role CT ops accounts for OPS-22 as role=path pairs (SUPPORT, OPERATIONS, POLYPOINT_EMPLOYEE, DATA_ANALYST), or 'none' (OPS-22 BLOCKED)

SUITE_REPORT.doc: absolute path of the Playwright JSON / HTML report the operator produced for OPS-23 part A, or 'none'

MASTER_FLAG_OK.doc: 'yes' when the operator approved the inert master flag of OPS-14 part B, else 'no'

PORTAL_HOST.doc: PolyPortal web host of the stage
